parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster in the GDN.

>  You can call the [DescribeGlobalDatabaseNetwork](~~264580~~) operation to view the ID of the cluster in the GDN.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb reset-global-database-network --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --gdn-id gdn-bp1fttxsrmv00000 --db-cluster-id pc-wz9fb5nn44u1d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
